name: סִינַי
summary: Sinai is the mountain in the wilderness of Sinai where Yahweh revealed himself and gave his law, and from which he goes before his people. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: Israel comes into the wilderness of Sinai in the third month.
The earth shook at the presence of God, “this Sinai”.

note: Moved from the former word entry `siynay` (old root key סיני), a place name entry made for Psalm 68 coverage. TIPNR’s Sinai@Exo.3.1 also holds Horeb.
